items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: I know a lot of piano players, but I forgot their name.

ctx.x: Well, there were some guys that played by the year that played all the black keys stuff, you know. Oh. With Birmingham and Black Pete. What about Sun Squawm? Big I Louie? I played with Big I Louie too.

Yeah. And that down there, he's playing with them. Where? Town of the Legends. Oh yeah. I was thinking of Big I Louie Robinson. He was a piano player. Robinson? I know a lot of piano players, but I forgot their name. Did you know Ed Mercier or...
Ed Mercier? Ed Mercier, yeah. Ed Mercier? Yeah. Ed Mercier? Yeah. Ed Mercier? Yeah. Yeah.
